title: Austin Funds for Affordable Housing
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved a nearly $14.9 million operating budget for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   This budget also established new program guidelines for housing initiatives and set administrative approval limits.
*   A separate $2 million capital budget was also passed to support the AHFC's housing development and programs.
*   Both budget approvals for the 2018-2019 fiscal year passed with a 10-1 vote.

>> Yes. Good afternoon, my name is Rosie truelove, the director of the Austin housing finance 
corporation. There are two items on the agenda today related to Austin housing finance corporation's 
budget, beginning October 1st, 2018, and ending September 30th, 2019. Item number 1 is to approve a 
resolution adopting the corporation's grant operating budget in the amount of $14,873,323. This item 
also authorizes program guidelines for the applicable housing programs funded and establishes 
administrative approval limits for the general manager. Item number 2 is to approve a resolution 
adopting the corporation's capital budget for fiscal year 2018-2019 in the amount of 2 million and I offer 
both of these items on consent.  
>> Mayor Adler: Is there a motion to approve these items on consent? Mr. Renteria makes that motion.
